meter.name: tracked query
meter.definition: One prompt, checked on every engine in your plan, on every refresh in your plan. Engines and refresh frequency are not separate meters.
meter.overage: Going over does not stop the scan. It shows a banner and bills the overage block at the end of the cycle.

free.label: Free scan
free.body: One domain, 25 queries, two engines. Your citation rate, the cause split, and your top three fixes — in about 90 seconds. Email only to save it.
free.limits: Competitor names hidden. No history. One scan per domain per day.

tiers.label: Starter
tiers.pitch: One brand, one person, weekly rhythm. Answers whether you have a problem.

tiers.label: Growth
tiers.pitch: The first plan that tells you who is winning instead of just that you are losing.
features: 5 seats, Slack, Search Console, read API
unlock: Competitor names and share of citations

tiers.label: Scale
tiers.pitch: Several brands, several markets, and someone who reports upward every month.
features: All engines, daily plus on demand
White label PDF, webhooks, write API

enterpriseTiers.label: Agency
enterpriseTiers.body: 25 client workspaces, 5,000 pooled queries, white label on every surface including the login domain. Client seats read-only and free. Reseller billing hides your cost. Extra workspace $29. Sold annually only.

enterpriseTiers.label: Enterprise
enterpriseTiers.body: SAML SSO, audit log export, data residency, signed DPA and MSA, invoicing, custom engines and prompt sets, security review, uptime commitment.
